{{Character Infobox |color={{poison color}} |corecolor={{poison color light}} |bordercolor={{poison color dark}} |name=Pop Roxie |jname=ホミカパパ |tmname=Homika's Papa |text=fff |image=Pop Roxie Adventures.png |size=200px |caption=Pop Roxie in [[Pokémon Adventures]] |gender=Male |hometown=Unknown, possibly [[Virbank City]] |region=[[Unova]] |relatives=[[Roxie]] (daughter) |hair=Black |eyes=Black }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{poison color light}} |gen={{gen|V}} |games={{B2W2|Black 2, White 2}} }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{poison color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |debut=''[[PS534|Choir Tournament]]'' }} |} '''Pop Roxie''' (Japanese: '''ホミカパパ''' ''Homika's Papa'') is a character appearing in {{B2W2}} and the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. He is the father of the [[Virbank Gym]] [[Gym Leader|Leader]] [[Roxie]]. ==In the core series games== Pop Roxie is a sailor who runs a ferry between [[Virbank City]] and [[Castelia City]]. He is first seen arguing with his daughter in front of Virbank's [[Pokémon Center]] over his movie career, insisting that since Roxie is both a Gym Leader and a musician, he can be both a sailor and a movie star. While he is auditioning at [[Pokéstar Studios]], the gate to the studios cannot be entered until the {{player}} obtains the {{Badge|Toxic}}. Upon entering Pokéstar Studios, the player watches Pop Roxie's first movie, ''Midlife Man of Justice vs. Brycen-Man'' of the [[Brycen-Man Series]]. As Riolu-Man, he ends up acting scared and being defeated. He later claims that one day, he will act once more. {{color2|fff|Brycen-Man Series|Brycen-Man}} |} ==In the spin-off games== ===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]=== Pop Roxie is mentioned in the [[Academy Founding Chapter]] event [[Explosive Art, Ninja's Craft]] by {{mas|Roxie}}, who details to {{mas|Mela}} about his dream of becoming a movie star. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== Pop Roxie debuted in ''[[PS534|Choir Tournament]]''. Roxie had her father take the students of the [[Aspertia City]] [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] to [[Castelia City]] as a reward for winning the [[Autumn Choir Tournament]]. Roxie later revealed that her father once wanted to be a movie star and planned on giving up his job as a ship captain to do so. When Pop Roxie saw {{adv|Blake}} and {{adv|Whitley}}'s performance at Pokéstar Studios, he realized that they were better than him and gave up. ==Names== {{langtable|color={{poison color light}}|bordercolor={{poison color dark}} |fr=Père de Strykna |de=Micas Papa |it=Papà di Velia |ko=보미카아빠 ''{{tt|Bomika Appa|Roxie's Papa}}'' |es=Padre de Hiedra }} ==Related articles== {{NPC|unova=yes|poison}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters]] [[Category:Actors]] [[Category:Sailors]] [[Category:Fathers]] [[de:Micas Papa]] [[it:Papà di Velia]] [[zh:霍米加的爸爸]]
